courses.summaryHtml:
Program Description

This program consists of a pathway program offered by StudyGroup at the International Study Centre at the University of Sussex followed by entry into a university program offered at the University of Sussex. In the International Year One programme, you will study courses related to your intended field of study alongside English to develop and enhance your skills as a student. Advancement into your intended program depends upon the successful completion of the pathway program.

The Pre-Masters in Business, Media and Social Sciences, provides a route to a variety of postgraduate degrees at the University of Sussex. English language and career skills are combined with subject-specific modules such as social sciences, cultural studies, and a variety of business skills such as accounting, finance and business management to provide you with a strong foundation for your chosen business, media and social sciences degree.

At Sussex, we believe art history matters and continues to be significant in today’s society.

This MA includes hands-on workshops and interactive sessions using the rich resources held in The Keep, Brighton’s world-class centre for archives. We also have partnerships with local and national museums and collections. These include the V&A, the National Portrait Gallery, Historic Royal Palaces, the National Trust, Brighton Museum & Art Gallery and Charleston – giving you access to expertise, art objects and research materials.

You’ll examine:

  • art’s place in 20th-century visual culture
  • museums and heritage
  • feminism and queer studies
  • criticism and the media.

You’ll be taught by professional curators as well as leading academics with established reputations for research. This means we can offer you expert guidance as you work on your own research, relevant to academia as well as the cultural and creative sectors beyond. On graduation, you’ll have the skills for both professional work and further study. Previous graduates having gone on to roles within prestigious institutions such as the British Museum, Soka Art Centre and Museum of London Archaeology (MOLA).

courses.subject: Architecture
courses.summaryHtml:
Program Description

The MArch (Part 2) is a long-established and well-respected course that is prescribed by the ARB and validated by the RIBA to give exemption from the second stage of professional education. The emphasis of the course is on innovative design work, and on developing a caring and critical approach to the study and practice of architecture.

The course fosters diversity of choice, interpretation and approach, whether in design projects or more academic research. The former focuses on sophisticated design programmes (in formal, technical, professional or urban terms) that demand rigour and self-criticism. The latter focuses on a major dissertation, an extended piece of specialised research into architecture and its historical or theoretical contexts.

The course has three main objectives: to develop a design ability through project-based experimentation; to present an evaluation and critique of coursework within a broad cultural context, and in light of technical, economic and legal constraints; and to promote the articulate explanation and representation of quality and value in design projects.

courses.name: Master of Arts – Architecture
courses.subject: Architecture
courses.summaryHtml:
The Architecture MA offers a unique opportunity for graduates interested in the intersection of architectural design, theory and research, encouraging students to develop their own positions and identities as creative practitioners and thinkers. A range of thematic and contextual concerns are offered and explored through the course using unconventional and imaginative methods of design, research and representation. These include cultural identity, architecture and society, political architecture, contested landscapes and digital design. These diverse fields of inquiry and their impact on cities are underpinned by integrating ‘other’ voices such as post-colonialism, critical theory, feminist theory and race studies. The course promotes methodological and representational innovation, with participants using techniques such as social mapping, interactive installations, film and conceptual modelling to stimulate projects towards high-levels of spatial, material and formal resolution.

A distinct and unique feature of the Architecture MA is its use of specialist pathways, namely Cultural Identity and Globalisation, Digital Media, and History and Theory. Students can elect to choose one of these routes through the programme – all of which incorporate option modules – graduating with the related named specialisation award, or else select their own combination of modules in order to graduate with the title MA Architecture. No matter how participants navigate their way through the course, it will inevitably be a dynamic journey of self-reflection and positioning to affirm interests and future practice concerns.

The MA ensures that students will receive a relevant, well-grounded, high-quality education and skill base, and a clear and comprehensive understanding of communication and the mass media. It is designed both for those who already work in or want to work in the media, and for those who want to go on to pursue further academic research in media and communication.

Based on continuous assessment, the course is taught in lectures and seminars by the team from Westminster’s top-rated Communication and Media Research Institute (CAMRI). They will be able to attend the regular talks by outside speakers (academics and practitioners) on a variety of communication and mass media issues.

The structure of the programme enables students to experiment from week to week, hone their craft and develop complete short stories as well as engage with the demands of longer-form prose.

In the first semester students will take modules in contemporary fiction and literary non-fiction, and also develop a project that addresses ways in which writers engage with community audiences. The second semester focuses on genre fiction and preparation for an Independent Study project, which is a substantial creative submission of 20-25,000 words written over the summer months. courses.summaryHtml:
The Approaches to the Past module, in the first semester, provides guidance on the different approaches to the study of history, including geographical scales of study and disciplinary approaches.

There are four core modules: Approaches to the Past, Research Methods and Skills, an Independent Study Presentation, and a dissertation. Students also choose three special study modules from a varied list of options. Examples include The Fall of the Ancient City; Sport and Leisure in Victorian Britain; Medieval Queenship-Gender and Power in the Global Middle Ages; The ‘fifteen-year war’ and public memory in postwar Japan; Documenting the Local Past; The Organisation and Representation of Colonial Violence; and Church, Society, and Conflict in the Medieval West, c. 1000 – c. 1150. Please note that not all the Special Study options will run every year

During the final summer of studies students will write a 20,000-word dissertation, with specialist supervision. Research training for the dissertation is provided in a specialist module through a blend of electronic learning and face-to-face contact, which helps students complete a range of research tasks associated with the development of their dissertation. This leads to a Day Conference (Independent Study Presentation), in which students showcase their dissertation plans and their development, and debate themes in the study of history with external speakers.

The MBA programme focuses on developing academic and managerial skills. An important objective is to provide relevant analytical training in the latest strategic managerial and organisational developments in both the public and private sectors. Students will collect and analyse relevant information across a range of areas pertaining to a current situation, synthesise the information into a form appropriate for evaluation of decision alternatives, and engage with people from different cultural backgrounds in order to raise the level of organisational awareness and thinking.

As a student on the MBA programme, students will study current management theory and acknowledged best practice in areas such as leadership, operations, corporate governance and sustainability. The programme includes coverage of human resource management and organisational behaviour. The study of financial analysis and decision-making emphasises the uses of financial and accounting data to inform and improve strategic decisions and operations. The coverage of business economics emphasises the external context, as well as the economic foundations, for business decision-making across a range of functional areas.

Arden's new MBA course has been specifically developed to provide students with a gateway to management and leadership roles. Whether someone already has management experience, or preparing for their first role in business, this MBA qualification will provide them with the skills and competence they need to excel in their career.

The ideal option if students are fresh out of their undergraduate degree or have limited work experience, this course gives students the unique opportunity to use their MBA qualification as a gateway into a managerial role. Students will develop in-depth industry knowledge of contemporary business operations and the ability to apply emerging trends and innovations to leverage strategic business transformations. Through its focus on the most up-to-date, practice-based learning, the course will help students gain the specialised skills required to start a successful career in today’s dynamic business environment.

Students will also be introduced to state-of-the-art virtual business simulations, helping them in responding to the many opportunities and challenges they might face in their future management role. By placing professional development at its core, students will graduate from the MBA with the workplace readiness to enter the business world with confidence.

That means that by the end of the course, students will have developed the real-world skills needed to lead and manage in today’s agile working environment. This, combined with the knowledge of how to drive positive business change will give students a powerful, modern skillset sought after by leading employers in a range of exciting industries.

courses.name: Master of Business Administration – Executive (MBA)
courses.subject: Business Administration – Executive
courses.summaryHtml:
The driving force behind Arden University’s Executive MBA is to help experienced managers disrupt conventional ways of thinking to lead business transformations. The programme equips students with the key skills needed for modern global business management, helping them gain a competitive edge in the industry. Rooted in a learning-by-doing methodology, the degree emphasises directly applying what students learn to their day-to-day role, allowing them to demonstrate immediate impact in their organisation. This, combined with Arden’s flexible learning, means this degree will complement students' careers, not get in the way of it.

With industries transforming faster than ever, organisations will require jobholders to be agile and tech-savvy. That’s why Arden has ensured this Executive MBA takes a digital-first, global, and contemporary approach to learning, ensuring students gain the modern strategic, financial, and people skills they need to meet the current and future demands of a constantly evolving sector. Arden's esteemed lecturers bring a wealth of experience from senior roles in both the private and public sectors, along with significant academic expertise. They have designed the course in consultation with leading UK employers and Arden's international alumni, so students can be confident their studies will provide them with the advanced skill set to become a future leader of tomorrow.

This course has dual accreditation from the Chartered Management Institute (CMI) and the Institute of Leadership and Management (ILM), providing students with the prestigious CMI Level 7 Diploma in Strategic Leadership and Management and ILM Level 7 Diploma in Leadership and Management. That means students will graduate with professional recognition and a qualification that’s recognised across the globe. And with the CMI Level 7 Diploma, students will be eligible for the fast-track route to Chartered Manager status.

The course is ideal for experienced managers who are looking to take their careers to the next level. Arden also offers MBA pathways focused on finance and artificial intelligence, as well as a specialised MBA to help those without work experience break into the world of business management.

courses.summaryHtml:
The Master of Business Administration - Environmental Management is a one-year course is intended for students with a keen interest in integrating environmental management with business practices. It includes free membership to IEMA, the professional body for Environmental and Sustainability. The role of the corporate environmental manager is becoming increasingly complex and strategic. Corporate social and environmental responsibility is becoming prominent in consumer demand and a pre-requisite for tender eligibility. This necessitates a more sophisticated environmental manager who can interpret legislative and audit requirements and deliver them in a manner conducive to continued economic development, whilst recognising the market trends.

The aim of this programme is to develop skills in the delivery of economic activities related to environment, green technology and sustainability. The programme includes highly topical case studies from across these sectors reflecting changing strategies and alternative approaches. The course is suitable for graduates in a wide range of disciplines, including Environment, Engineering, Finance, Social Sciences and other subjects.

The Master of Business Administration in Finance course will develop knowledgeable and capable executives, who will move quickly into key positions in the financial sector. It focuses on the operation of financial markets and the strategic management of financial entities.

The course will be of particular interest to:

  • Graduates who have professional experience in the financial sector.
  • Managers and accountants in public and private organizations who wish to develop their financial management skills.
  • Managers employed in the financial services industry.
  • Graduates contemplating a career in the banking and financial services industry.
  • Graduates who have relevant practical experience and wish to enhance their skills in the areas of banking and finance.
  • Finance professionals (like corporate treasurers and accountants) who deal with the financial services industry.

Students will gain practical insight and skills in a range of financial and strategic management topics in financial services and markets. They will develop an appreciation of the causes and significance of current developments in the financial and corporate sectors. Case studies and contemporary issues figure prominently in the programme.

On this course students will develop advanced, specialised knowledge and skills across a broad range of business and management subjects, developing knowledge and understanding of international organisations, their management and the changing global external environment in which they operate; thus developing a strategic overview of business and organisational issues. They will also develop advanced theoretical knowledge of international business and management subjects including finance, marketing and entrepreneurship and how these are affected by culture.

This programme is accredited by the Chartered Management Institute (CMI). Students of this programme will graduate with the dual award of a Bangor University Masters and a Level 7 Diploma in Strategic Management and Leadership.

courses.name: International Master of Business Administration (MBA)
courses.subject: Business Administration
courses.summaryHtml:
The International MBA programme in Birmingham is designed to provide students with a global perspective on management, preparing them to navigate the complexities of a rapidly changing international business environment. It recognises the need for future managers to adopt flexible approaches to thinking and behaviour in order to succeed in increasingly dynamic and unpredictable markets.

The programme explores the evolving nature of global business and equips students with the skills, knowledge, and mindset required to operate effectively across different sectors and countries. It also focuses on developing leadership capabilities, enabling graduates to lead organisations in a wide range of contexts.

Combining academic rigour with practical skill development, the course is tailored to meet the needs of contemporary international businesses. It places strong emphasis on employability, helping students build communication, interpersonal, analytical, and strategic thinking skills, alongside creative problem-solving and research capabilities. Graduates are equipped with a broad understanding of key business areas including strategy, marketing, leadership, finance, global human resource management, international business, entrepreneurship, operations and project management.

The course also supports entrepreneurial ambitions, offering opportunities to develop and test business ideas in a supportive environment. Students benefit from studying within a diverse international community and from strong industry links, including company visits, sponsored study trips, and internship opportunities that provide valuable real-world experience.

The MBA at Bournemouth University is a carefully designed course that prepares students to tackle the realities of the modern business world, incorporating emerging technologies and aligning with the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (UN SDGs).

Students have the opportunity to advance their leadership and managerial skills through consultancy projects and industry engagements, allowing them to apply their knowledge in real-world business contexts.

The programme builds confidence in addressing complex business challenges through innovative and creative assessments.

BU fosters a community of lifelong learning, with students gaining associate membership to respected organisations such as AACSB, BGA, CMI, and IDM.

With academic expertise drawn from across Bournemouth University’s Faculties, the MBA programme is continuously evolving to remain at the forefront of change and advancement across all sectors. The course serves as a strong foundation for students aiming to build and progress in a managerial career.

Roles the Masters of Business Administration graduates are in include

  • Director
  • Lead Project Manager
  • Head of Economic Development Services
  • Head of Information and Systems Development

Industries worked in:

  • Business
  • Finance
  • Marketing
  • Human Resources.

courses.summaryHtml:
At the postgraduate level, Brunel University London Pathway College provides the highly acclaimed Pre-Master's programme leading to an excellent range of Brunel University London Master programmes in business and management, computing, engineering & design and arts. After successfully completing the programme students will advance to their chosen progression degree.

A postgraduate pathway will give students valuable insight into postgraduate-level studies in the UK. Most importantly, It will equip students with the appropriate knowledge and skills they need to excel in their chosen taught master's degree.

The educational aims of the programme element are to:

  1. Develop in students fundamental knowledge and understanding of business and its internal and external operating processes, inclusive of planning and strategy, growth, marketing, products/services, finance and accounting systems, information systems, and the management and development of human resource within organisations.
  2. Develop in students an appreciation and desire to learn based on competent intellectual and practical skills that build to a set of transferable skills that will support them in all aspects of their onward academic studies/careers and support their decision making in an informed manner.
  3. Ensure that students have attained the prescribed level of inter-disciplinary language competence.
  4. Prepare students for postgraduate study to meet the required academic standards.

Business Administration MBA

The General Management MBA specialisation can help students become a more accomplished manager all-round. From finance to international strategy, harnessing technologies and marketing, this course will help students with senior management decision-making and solving business issues. Brunel University London supports their students in identifying their strengths and weaknesses and working with them to help them progress.

The Career Development Programme is an integral part of professional development while students are studying their MBA. Landing a top job after completing their MBA is, of course, a key objective, and the Career Development Programme is designed to provide the tools to help students achieve their ambitions. The programme will help students define their career goals and create a personalised career action plan.

Students will have access to one-to-one careers coaching to help students understand what makes them stand, out whether it’s their particular management experience and skills or specialist knowledge. Brunel University London will also help students with their CV, LinkedIn profile, and a professional portfolio as well as providing support in building a career plan, job-hunting, writing applications that get noticed, and brushing up on interview techniques.

As part of the MBA course, Brunel provides an innovative series of Leadership Masterclasses. Sessions will help students with effective ways to present their ideas, the best methods for managing change, negotiating better and resolving conflict, as well as giving students deeper insight into cross cultural issues and corporate responsibility.

The Brunel Business School has links to many leading organisations such as Barclays, British Airways, Goldman Sachs, HSBC, IBM, Iraq Energy Institute, Jaguar, Johnson and Johnson, Microsoft, and Xerox. MBA students undertake regular visits to company head offices and representatives from these companies often visit campus as part of the MBA Guest Speaker Series, Let’s Talk Business.

The Brunel MBA is one of a distinguished group of MBA programmes worldwide to have achieved accreditation by both the Association of Masters of Business Administration (AMBA) and the Association to Advance Collegiate Schools of Business (AACSB).

courses.summaryHtml:
The Canterbury Christ Church MBA International is primarily designed for recent university graduates who have little or no prior work experience but are interested in developing a future career in international business and management. The course aims to engage and educate students in preparation for managerial and career roles in the international business arena. The course has a strong emphasis on employability for careers in business, management and policy making.

The MBA International will encourage stringent and critical professional development, engaging students with the systematic review of international business theories, policies and practice. It will reflect an international body of thinking and study, and investigation of international business problems in the current, complex environment.

It will help students gain insights into the latest trends in international business, as well as UK private and public sector organisations. With the experience of the leading team of researchers and professional practice tutors, the University will ensure the MBA International course maintains a pragmatic focus to enhance students' business career.

The course will provide students with the necessary knowledge, skills and expertise required in a dynamic, unpredictable and unprecedented global trading environment. Graduates can also engage in further research on the MPhil/PhD programme.

courses.summaryHtml:
The Cardiff MBA program is delivered in immersive blocks that are specifically designed to stimulate the curiosity of the students, inform their process of inquiry, and strengthen the application of their learning. Each block of learning consists of a diverse range of activities, such as company visits, industry speakers, time-limited challenges, role-play, and simulations.

The students benefit from small group work and block teaching, which allows them to master specific interdisciplinary approaches before having the opportunity to develop a specialization through the accelerator project. The program concludes with a capstone module that brings together the various areas of expertise acquired throughout the MBA experience.

The diversity of the student cohort and academic staff is considered a valuable asset. Students have the chance to collaborate with their peers, academics, and practitioners in order to challenge their existing knowledge structures, assumptions, values, and skills. This collaborative environment encourages students to reconsider their current understanding and explore issues from different perspectives.

The MBA program is designed to address real-world challenges, and this is reflected in the assessment of the students' work. Similar to the workplace, students are required to complete assessment tasks individually and as part of a team, covering areas such as strategy, personnel, consultancy, innovation, and crisis.

This program structure provides students with the opportunity to customize their MBA experience through six challenge-focused modules, offering flexibility to align with their career aspirations.

Contemporary integrated themes run through all modules, such as the future of work, responsible leadership, and digital transformation. The reader will also have the opportunity to study a specialist module on Artificial Intelligence, which will be taught within the Data Science Academy in the School of Computer Science and Informatics.

Alongside students from various backgrounds and with diverse experiences, the reader will have the chance to develop their business knowledge, increase their self-awareness, and sharpen their ability as an effective and inspiring leader. They will consider the broader commercial, social, and environmental implications of decision-making in a variety of practical contexts. Additionally, they will have the opportunity to understand the management challenges associated with the application of artificial intelligence and machine learning within business. As a member of the Cardiff Business School community, the reader will benefit from opportunities to make a difference to society and the economy through study and extra-curricular activities in line with Public Value.

The curriculum covers core MBA subjects such as leadership, strategic management, finance, and marketing, alongside specialized topics including data analytics, machine learning, business intelligence, and digital transformation. The program emphasizes practical, real-world applications through case studies, projects, and the use of industry-relevant software and tools. Students also develop critical thinking, problem-solving, and leadership skills necessary to navigate the rapidly evolving digital business landscape.

Graduates are prepared for roles in business analytics, data-driven management, consulting, and leadership positions across various industries, or for further professional advancement in the field of business and technology.

courses.name: Master of Business Administration (MBA) – Management with Health Data Analytics and AI
courses.subject: Management with Health Data Analytics and AI
courses.summaryHtml:
The MBA Management with Health Data Analytics and AI at Health Sciences University combines strategic healthcare management with applied knowledge of data analytics and responsible artificial intelligence. Students develop the ability to interpret complex evidence, make informed decisions, lead multidisciplinary teams, and support improvements in healthcare through practical learning.

As data, digital technologies, and AI become increasingly important in healthcare, the programme develops strategic management and leadership capabilities alongside specialist knowledge of analytics, data governance, and technology-enabled innovation. It emphasises responsible decision-making and the safe use of emerging technologies.

Students learn to interpret evidence and apply it to strategic, operational, and clinical decisions. They also examine governance and ethical considerations associated with adopting AI in healthcare management. Learning is considered across public, private, and third-sector healthcare settings, including service providers and organisations that supply healthcare products.

Specialist study is complemented by core subjects in global health policy, people management and leadership, and marketing strategy. This enables students to connect their knowledge of data and technology with broader organisational priorities.

Delivered through a combination of on-campus and online study in London, the 15-month programme incorporates healthcare case studies, live organisational briefs, and consultancy activities. A dedicated three-month component gives students the option of completing a university-based live consultancy project or undertaking an external professional practice placement. External placements are competitive, are not guaranteed, and may involve additional costs.

courses.name: Master of Business Administration (MBA) – Management with Health Economics and Finance
courses.subject: Management with Health Economics and Finance
courses.summaryHtml:
The MBA Management with Health Economics and Finance at Health Sciences University develops specialist knowledge of healthcare economics alongside strategic management skills. Students explore healthcare funding, resource allocation, and financial risk, learning to use economic evidence to inform decisions about service spending, the sustainability of health systems, and healthcare delivery.

The programme examines how healthcare decision-makers balance population needs, patient outcomes, and financial sustainability. Students develop an understanding of economic analysis and financial management, with specialist study in healthcare funding, budgeting, resource allocation, systems risk, and governance.

Drawing on the management expertise of the Health Sciences University Health Business School, students study comparative health economics and policy alongside leadership, people management, and marketing strategy. International examples enable them to compare healthcare systems, assess spending priorities, and evaluate funding risks.

The knowledge developed is relevant to roles in healthcare organisations, regulatory bodies, government, and consultancy. Students learn to connect economic evidence with practical management decisions.

Delivered through a combination of on-campus and online study in London, the 15-month programme includes applied research and a dedicated three-month work-based learning component. Students can investigate an organisational challenge and present recommendations through a live consultancy project based at the university, or undertake a relevant external professional practice placement. External placements are competitive, are not guaranteed, and may involve additional costs.

courses.name: Master of Business Administration (MBA) – Management with Healthcare Supply Chain Management
courses.subject: Management with Healthcare Supply Chain Management
courses.summaryHtml:
The MBA Management with Healthcare Supply Chain Management at Health Sciences University develops management expertise in healthcare procurement, logistics, and facilities operations. Students explore how supplier selection, resource coordination, and sustainable supply chains contribute to effective healthcare delivery, applying their learning to real organisational challenges.

The programme examines how healthcare services rely on effective sourcing, dependable logistics, and well-managed facilities. Students develop knowledge of supplier analysis, tendering, resource management, and budgeting, and consider how operational decisions can support safe and sustainable healthcare services.

Specialist study in healthcare supply chain management, project management, and systems thinking is complemented by subjects taught through the Health Business School, including global health policy, leadership, people management, and marketing strategy. Learning addresses governance, health and safety, and sustainability across hospitals, pharmaceutical organisations, healthcare product manufacturers, and suppliers. International supply chains are also explored, particularly in relation to organisations that produce and distribute healthcare products.

Delivered through a combination of on-campus and online study in London, the 15-month programme includes applied research and a dedicated three-month work-based learning component. Students can investigate an organisational challenge and present recommendations through a live consultancy project based at the university, or pursue a relevant external professional practice placement. External placements are competitive, are not guaranteed, and may involve additional costs.

courses.summaryHtml:
Business innovation and leadership transformation are the driving forces behind the Kingston Master of Business Administration (MBA) course.

Build a tailored MBA, whether students work for a large organisation or are planning their first start up. High-quality, informed teaching will give them practical skills, help them make effective business decisions, think creatively and find solutions to real-life challenges. Sustainability, ethical business and corporate social responsibility are incorporated into all modules. Kingston Business School has a strong focus on innovation and entrepreneurship, including an incubation programme and co-working space.

This course is accredited by AMBA, the global standard for all programmes. An MBA at Kingston will develop students' personal capacity and leadership skills, and help them build a career plan to meet their ambitions. Kingston Business School is one of only five per cent of the world's business schools to be accredited by AACSB International. This course will prepare students to identify and embrace potential opportunities whilst developing their creative capacities and collaborative approach in order to be successful in different environments.

Some examples of well-known organisations Kingston's alumni have worked for include; GSK, AstraZeneca PLC, RBS, Tata Consultancy Services, NHS, Amazon Internet Services PVT Ltd, Occidental Petroleum, MS Amlin, SberBank, BTS Telecom, Deloitte Digital, EY.... to name but a few.

courses.subject: Business Administration
courses.summaryHtml:
The Master of Business Administration at Lincoln Bishop University is a postgraduate programme designed to develop the strategic, analytical, and leadership capabilities required to manage organisations in a complex and rapidly changing global business environment. It is suitable for professionals, aspiring managers, entrepreneurs, and graduates seeking to advance into leadership or senior management roles.

The programme provides an integrated understanding of key business areas, which may include strategic management, leadership, marketing, finance, operations, human resource management, entrepreneurship, innovation, and responsible business practices. Through case studies, practical projects, group activities, presentations, and independent research, students learn to assess business challenges, make evidence-based decisions, and develop effective organisational strategies.

Students are expected to strengthen their abilities in critical thinking, problem-solving, communication, teamwork, and change management. The programme also explores contemporary issues such as digital transformation, sustainability, ethical leadership, globalisation, and the impact of technology on organisations.

A significant component of the MBA may involve an independent research project, dissertation, or consultancy-based project. This allows students to investigate a relevant business issue, apply appropriate research methods, and recommend practical solutions.

courses.name: Master of Business Administration (MBA) – Master of Business Administration
courses.subject: Business Administration (MBA)
courses.summaryHtml:
The world of business and work is changing rapidly. With automation, AI, online working, climate change and diversity, students will need to be prepared to face and respond to change.

The MBA has been designed using advice and insight from large organisations and business entrepreneurs. This course aims to prepare students for greater business responsibility, switching industries or job roles, or to start their own business.

Students will gain practical skills and experience through business simulations, where they will be making real business decisions to ensure the imitation businesses make a profit and can operate. The first simulation focuses on understanding business finance and accounting, while the second focuses on global strategy. These will involve analysing finances, the supply chain and operations. Most importantly, students will gain experience of working in a team to make decisions in a competitive environment and then deal with the results. London Metropolitan University is one of the few universities in the UK that incorporates business simulation activities into the course.

Students will refine their complex problem solving skills and develop their critical thinking abilities. The MBA will help develop their management skills, how to work effectively in teams, take on the leadership of a diverse group and influence others.

The business world is a volatile environment. Students will study the impact of accelerating climate change, technology development and global politics on the UK’s business economy, learning how to make fundamental business decisions in uncertain times and with incomplete data.

Insights into the wider role of businesses in addressing societal problems in a sustainable manner will also develop their understanding of ethical management and governance.

Students may have had a break from studies and been in the work environment for some time. To help them prepare for the MBA, London Metropolitan University has developed a one-week bootcamp module to help build students develop their skills and knowledge prior to starting the course, so that they can really maximise their learning potential on the course. This bootcamp will help students establish what their specific goals are and serve as a personal development plan to help keep them on track throughout their studies. It’s completed online the week before students start their first module.

Students will be taught by industry specialists in finance, strategy, creativity, marketing, operations coaching and networking, who have years of practitioner experience.

The aim is for students to graduate with a broad understanding of how businesses operate, how they are managed and how they’re governed. This MBA will prepare students for a more senior role in business, a change in career direction or to go on and start their own business.

An International Bright Futures Scholarship in the amount of £3,000 will automatically be applied to eligible students with overseas fee status starting a degree with London Met in the 2024/25 academic year. This scholarship includes a tuition fee reduction for the duration of students' studies and is applicable to both undergraduate and postgraduate courses.

Tuition Deposit is £4,000 for all students excluding those from Punjab and Haryana for whom the deposit amount will remain at 50%

courses.summaryHtml:
The Level 6 Pre-Master’s Programme (PMP) is a two-semester programme, with guaranteed progression to a wide range of Master’s degrees at Loughborough University.

This Pre-Master’s Programme (PMP) is designed to prepare international students for postgraduate study in the United Kingdom. The PMP will allow them to improve their English while learning the study skills and research methods that they will need during their Master's degree studies. They will study academic modules relating to their chosen progression route. Each semester consists of thirteen teaching weeks, one reading week, and an assessment week. The weekly hours of study varies by semester with them on average studying around 18-21 (and up to 21) hours per week. Each module will have an assessment schedule, which will be completed by the end of the appropriate semester. Assessments will be designed to demonstrate learning across the individual modules of the programme and to allow them to experience a wide range of the assessment methods used in United Kingdom postgraduate programmes. Assessments will include coursework, essays, reports and other structured assignments, oral examination and unseen written examinations.

courses.subject: Business Administration (MBA)
courses.summaryHtml:
Program Description

The Nottingham Trent University Business School MBA is designed to enhance the student's management knowledge, their leadership capabilities, their global perspective and their professional career. It has been awarded a Dual Award status by the Chartered Management Institute (CMI).

Nottingham Trent University's MBA has three core principles at heart:

  1. The principles of responsible and sustainable management are central to Nottingham Trent University's School and the programme. Nottingham Trent University will help the student to develop the insights, capacities and skills to create and maintain responsible, efficient business practices, as well as to develop their sustainable mind-set, promote responsible leadership and influence organisational cultures.
  2. The learning style and opportunities are characterised by experiential learning, manifest in the two consultancy projects and a pedagogy designed to increase opportunities for experiential elements in each module.
  3. Nottingham Trent University offers a personalised pathway, with the freedom to specialise in the areas that interest the student the most and to shape their skills and experiences around the career they want.

The Nottingham Business School MBA aims to prepare the student to be more informed across all areas of business administration so that they are able to take up senior strategic management roles as part of their career progression.

Nottingham Trent University has designed a curriculum which will challenge the student's thinking, stretch the boundaries of their knowledge and demand reflection on their previous managerial decisions and actions. If the student takes the programme seriously and goes beyond the minimum requirement to pass, it will help them to consider how to be an ethical and effective leader so that they can make a positive contribution to their future organisation, employees and society.

What the student will gain from this degree

  • Nottingham Trent University offers a more hands-on experience than most other UK business schools. The student will complete two hands-on experience projects; one within the UK and the other one internationally.
  • Nottingham Trent University's Personal, Professional and Leadership Development module will include opportunities for academic and industrial mentoring, careers support and individual personal and professional development based around the student's needs.
  • The student will develop global management skills and immerse themselves in a multicultural atmosphere, with a dynamic community of staff and students from around the world.
  • The student will articulate a critical understanding of the contemporary issues, theories and conceptual frameworks used to explain and guide management and leadership activities in organisations.
  • The student will critically appraise the range of tools and techniques required to transform the culture and capabilities of organisations to meet the challenges of a turbulent and dynamic business environment.

courses.summaryHtml:
This programme is ideal for graduates and professionals who are looking to progress their career and advance their standing in business and the creative industries.

During this MBA at Ravensbourne University London, students will develop global perspectives, broaden their horizons and become experts in evaluating current challenges in business management. During the course, students will take an in-depth look at business management and administration and will participate in a collaborative working environment. Through a series of business lectures and classes taught by industry and academic professionals, they will develop a varied skill-set to enable them to progress their career in business and management. Students will be pushed outside of their comfort zone to enhance their leadership skills and be put to the test through simulated tasks emulating real world practice.

They will study in a supportive environment with like-minded individuals who can share their ideas and vision. courses.summaryHtml:
The Ravensbourne MBA is a future-oriented, evidence-led postgraduate programme designed for professionals aspiring to lead with impact in today’s fast-paced, interconnected, and technology-driven world.

Combining academic rigour with practical insight, the MBA equips participants with the knowledge, tools, and mindset required to make confident, responsible, and innovative decisions across diverse industries. Through a dynamic curriculum grounded in real-world relevance, participants engage with contemporary global business challenges through simulations, live case studies, consultancy-style projects, and an applied capstone research experience.

At the core of the programme is the Ravensbourne 5Cs Framework, a distinctive model for leadership and professional development built around five critical capabilities:

  • Commercial Competence: Mastery of business fundamentals to drive sustainable growth and strategic advantage.
  • Confidence: The ability to lead decisively in complex and evolving contexts.
  • Communication: Clear and persuasive engagement with a range of stakeholders.
  • Compassion: Ethical leadership grounded in inclusivity, empathy, and social responsibility.
  • Creative Commitment: The use of innovation and design thinking to solve problems and deliver value in a sustainable and profitable manner.

Throughout the programme, participants apply evidence-based approaches to decision-making and problem-solving, using data and insights to support strategic action.

Assessment is 100% coursework-based and includes a rich mix of presentations, analytical reports, collaborative projects, and industry-facing research tasks designed to reflect real-world business practice and leadership challenges.

The Ravensbourne MBA develops agile, confident, and ethically grounded leaders capable of thriving in a rapidly changing global economy and shaping the future of business with purpose and creativity.

Combining strategic business management with specialist knowledge in transformation and innovation, the course develops the skills needed to navigate organisational change and deliver long-term business improvement.

Students will study core MBA disciplines such as strategic management, evidence-based decision-making, stakeholder influence and measuring business success, while also exploring business strategy and digital transformation and sustainable approaches to project delivery. The course encourages students to consider how organisations can adapt to disruption, embrace digital innovation and implement transformation strategies that create sustainable value.

The final project enables students to apply their learning to a real-world organisational challenge, investigating opportunities for business development, operational change or innovation.

courses.name: Global Master of Business Administration (MBA)
courses.subject: Business Administration
courses.summaryHtml:
Business leaders today are facing unprecedented challenges, including economic uncertainty, technological change and shifting international markets. The Global MBA prepares students to address these challenges and succeed in an increasingly interconnected world.

Designed for ambitious professionals and graduates seeking to accelerate their careers, the MBA focuses on global challenges, digital transformation and responsible leadership. Students explore how organisations operate across international markets, examine the impact of emerging technologies such as AI and blockchain, and learn how businesses can respond to ethical and economic challenges on a global scale.

Through practical learning, expert teaching from international lecturers and a live consultancy project, students develop the confidence and skills needed to lead organisations through complexity and change. The Global MBA provides a flexible and practical route to developing advanced business and leadership skills.

Students study a series of 30-credit modules that build knowledge and skills across key areas of management before applying their learning to a live consultancy project.

Instead of completing a traditional dissertation, students work on a real business challenge for an organisation. This approach enables students to develop practical, evidence-based solutions in a professional setting rather than focusing solely on a theoretical exercise. Students gain experience in applying their thinking to genuine deadlines and graduate with a real-life example of the value they can bring to an organisation.

The forward-thinking Global MBA focuses on real-world business challenges, embedding international perspectives and AI across the modules to reflect the realities of modern business.

Key areas of study include

  • Core business foundations: Develops a strong grounding in finance, marketing, operations, people and strategy.
  • AI and digital transformation: Explores how digital technologies are reshaping industries and decision-making and how they can drive smarter business outcomes.
  • Global perspective: Develops an international mindset while examining how culture, geopolitics and economics influence global business.
  • Leadership in practice: Strengthens the ability to lead teams, manage complex situations and communicate effectively.
  • Entrepreneurial thinking: Develops innovative and agile approaches to problem-solving.
  • Personal development: Builds confidence and resilience while supporting professional development and clearer career direction.
  • Ethical business: Develops responsible leadership skills through an understanding of the ethical, social and sustainability challenges facing businesses today.

courses.subject: Specialism in Business Analytics
courses.summaryHtml:
The MBA with Specialism in Business Analytics course provides a progression route to Master's level for those who have completed a first degree and who wish to continue with their professional development at an advanced level.

At the core of our course is a focus on how best to enable learners to develop advanced capabilities and understanding to make a significant contribution to business and/or professional objectives. Learning opportunities will address the contemporary and future challenges and issues faced by managers, including: the influx of innovative technologies and digital narratives; diversity and difference; sustainable initiatives; anticipating and creating change; changing demographics and employee expectations; evolving customer/client expectations; the need for intergenerational collaboration; working in flatter organisations and individualisation, staying agile and being ambidextrous.

For effective learning to take place, we implement the concept of the 'reflective practitioner', where we draw on the differing experiences of participants and tutor team as a resource.

This takes place through a systematic process of study, reflection and consideration, to optimise the benefits of learning. Learners will be encouraged to engage in dialogue and discussion and share their ideas and current work experiences with others in the group. The 'process' will involve a range of approaches to facilitate learning, including:

  • dialogue; focusing on a topic or group of related ideas to improve understanding
  • advising; by offering perspective on a best course of action or the nature of the situation
  • viewpoint; offering a range of points of view or standpoints.

It is expected that learners will engage with the curriculum to lead them to new ways of thinking, to evaluate and develop insights and sound analytical and management skills and then, where appropriate, to apply the skills and knowledge they acquire on the course by transferring and applying them to the workplace. Assignments are therefore designed to reflect this with learners usually encouraged to work on 'real life' problems/issues from their own workplace, which requires an ability to apply theoretical concepts in practice.

courses.summaryHtml:
The Master of Business Administration (MBA Global) at Derby provides in-depth, applied knowledge of digital platforms, artificial intelligence, and sustainable business practices, preparing graduates to become responsible, authentic, and future-ready business leaders.

The programme offers the opportunity to undertake a six-month social impact project, enabling the practical application of skills to address current organisational and societal challenges while delivering tangible value to real businesses. Students study alongside peers from around the world and build strong professional networks across the private, public, and third sectors through collaborative, practice-based learning. Teaching is delivered by academics engaged in cutting-edge research and consultancy with leading global ‘blue-chip’ organisations, ensuring that learning remains current, relevant, and informed by real industry practice. Full-time international students also have the option to undertake a 9–12 month placement in a relevant sector in the UK, gaining hands-on professional experience and significantly enhancing employability within a competitive global job market.

The contemporary business and commercial environment is evolving at an exponential pace, driven by disruptive technologies and increasing demands for responsible and sustainable business development. Organisations seeking to succeed in this rapidly changing landscape require leaders and managers equipped with advanced knowledge, professional skills, ethical traits, and strong behavioural capabilities to navigate uncertainty, add strategic value, and support organisational growth. The MBA Global programme is designed to cultivate these competencies, with a focus on digital innovation, artificial intelligence, modern working practices, and the embedding of sustainability into business decision-making and leadership.

For full-time international students, the degree may be studied with a 9–12 month UK-based industry placement integrated into the programme, subject to successful completion of all taught modules. Dedicated support is provided through the Careers and Employment Service alongside the MBA Global programme team, including tailored guidance for placement applications, networking events, CV development workshops, and interview skills training to enhance professional readiness.

The curriculum is aligned to key global initiatives, including the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals, ensuring a strong emphasis on responsible leadership and ethical business practice. Students develop a comprehensive understanding of how value can be created in ways that enhance organisations, employees, consumers, wider society, and the natural environment. The programme aims to produce graduates capable of generating innovative insights and proposing effective solutions to contemporary business challenges while demonstrating the values and professional standards expected by organisations and society both now and in the future.

courses.name: Master of Business Administration (MBA) – Global Block Delivery
courses.subject: Business Administration (MBA) – Global Block Delivery
courses.summaryHtml:
The MBA Global is an innovative programme designed for working professionals seeking to gain an internationally recognised management qualification without taking a career break. The course combines short, intensive on-campus study periods with flexible off-site learning, enabling participants to balance academic commitments with professional responsibilities regardless of global location. The programme is accredited by the Chartered Management Institute (CMI), allowing graduates to apply for Chartered Manager status upon completion. An alternative to the traditional dissertation is offered through a corporate placement project, which enables participants to address a significant real-world organisational challenge with direct practical impact. Teaching is delivered by a highly experienced team of business and management specialists, and students study within small, professionally diverse cohorts, supported by enhanced academic tutoring designed to ensure consistent progress throughout the programme.

The MBA Global is structured to meet the increasing global demand for managers capable of performing, thinking, and leading from an international perspective. It aims to nurture creative, dynamic, and innovative leaders equipped to succeed in senior positions worldwide. This contemporary MBA programme challenges participants both academically and practically, developing the ability to analyse and resolve complex business problems that are directly relevant to professional practice, while encouraging positive change within organisations and industry sectors.

The block delivery format typically attracts senior managers and professional executives from a wide array of industries, including construction, energy, aviation, and the public sector. Lecturers bring substantial business and management experience, combining academic expertise with real-world practice. Their ongoing engagement in influential research and consultancy ensures that teaching content remains current and industry-relevant. Programme delivery is further strengthened by partnerships with regional, national, and international employers and leading professional bodies, including organisations such as Rolls-Royce, Boots, JCB, Toyota, Bombardier, DHL, the NHS, and international government ministries.

A strong emphasis is placed on global business thinking, reflecting the growing need for leaders to adopt perspectives that extend beyond domestic markets. Each module advances applied knowledge of business within international and global contexts. Teaching takes place within small but highly diverse classroom environments, encouraging active discussion, shared learning, and the exchange of professional best practice among participants from a wide range of cultural and professional backgrounds. The MBA Global attracts students from across mainland Europe and worldwide, including the United States, India, China, Pakistan, Nigeria, and the Gulf States, fostering a rich international learning community.

The programme curriculum covers key areas such as responsible and authentic leadership, entrepreneurship and innovation, strategy, finance and business transformation, sustainable business operations, research methods, digital marketing strategies for international markets, business analytics for strategic decision-making, independent dissertation study, and a social impact project.

Students will study a broad range of business functions, which includes strategic marketing, sustainable operations, accounting and finance.

The Director’s Workshops are integral to The Essex MBA and run as one and two-day workshops at key stages of the programme. The sessions may include presentations from industry practitioners, interactive group activities and opportunities to work with business incubators. The Director’s Workshops give students the opportunity to relate current business issues to content taught in the modules and develop the professional skills. Recent examples include sessions on personal branding, new business creation, business ethics, risk management, big data for small businesses, value proposition development and business consultancy.

This course begins with one week of activities to develop students' networking, team work and adaptive thinking skills. It ends with a Capstone, where students choose to complete a dissertation, comprehensive business plan or consultancy project that can be tailored to their professional experience or goals.

The University of Essex hopes to foster students' entrepreneurial spirit, so they can build sustainable, resilient business models that make sense to shareholders and the environment and respond to economic pressures, such as the current COVID-19 pandemic. Students explore the impact of internationalisation on businesses, suppliers and customers and gain the skills to lead in increasingly demanding marketplaces.

courses.subject: Business Administration (MBA)
courses.summaryHtml:
Program Description

If students hold a bachelor’s degree or equivalent, but don’t meet the entry requirements for a master’s, a Pre-Master’s can help them gain a place on a postgraduate degree. For progression to the 1st year of a postgraduate degree at the University of Essex. Course length is determined mainly by students' English language level (UKVI IELTS score).

Students on all course lengths take a set of common or similar modules to gain a solid base of skills for university. If their course is longer than 2 terms, students will take additional modules designed to improve one or more of their English language level, academic skills, and basic knowledge of particular subjects.

Master of Business Administration (MBA)

The University of Essex MBA seeks to develop socially responsible entrepreneurs delivering sustainable business. Their students are talented, ambitious and full of energy. They possess an entrepreneurial spirit that Essex does their best to foster. Essex's MBAs aspire to achieve lasting positive change for themselves and those around them. Essex aims to inspire them to create the world they want to live in.

Students will study a broad range of business functions, known as the MBA Essentials, which includes:

  • strategic marketing
  • sustainable operations
  • accounting and finance

Essex hopes to foster the students' entrepreneurial spirits, so they can build sustainable, resilient business models that make sense to shareholders and the environment. Students explore the impact of internationalisation on businesses, suppliers and customers and gain the skills to lead in increasingly demanding marketplaces.

Essex's Director’s Workshops are integral to The Essex MBA and run as one and two-day workshops at key stages of the programme. The sessions may include company visits, trips to business incubators and presentations from industry practitioners, as well as Essex's specialist academics. The Director’s Workshops gives students the opportunity to relate current business issues to content taught in their modules and develop their professional skills. Recent examples include sessions on personal branding, new business creation, business ethics, risk management, big data for small businesses, value proposition development and company visits to the likes of Adnams PLC, Cambridge Science Park and HSBC.

The course begins with one week of activities to develop networking, team work and adaptive thinking skills. It ends with a Capstone, where students choose to complete a dissertation, comprehensive business plan or consultancy project that can be tailored to their professional experience or goals.

Essex's MBA is taught at Essex Business School, which is located at the heart of the Knowledge Gateway, the research and technology park on their Colchester Campus. The Knowledge Gateway also incorporates Parkside Office Village, an SME hotspot, and the Innovation Centre, which is home to the University’s Start-Up Hub.

Essex's world-class MBA tutors have both academic and extensive private sector experience and are at the cutting-edge of research in: business ethics and corporate social responsibility; organisation studies; leadership and strategy; finance and banking; risk management; and international management.

Studying with Essex in the Essex MBA is an excellent investment in a future career. Essex connects students with the latest developments in business by bringing in practitioners from leading companies to talk about contemporary business issues as well as experts in the MBA graduate jobs market.

Throughout the course, students benefit from professional links, such as:

  • hearing from visiting speakers who offer insight into contemporary business issues;
  • visits to inspiring local firms to learn from their success;
  • connections with business incubators to see first-hand the issues of starting a business;
  • networking events with resident businesses

Essex's MBA students have gained posts in a range of businesses, including large corporations, and have used their qualification as the catalyst to start their own businesses.

In a typical week, learning takes place through a combination of lectures and seminars. Students will be able to discuss and develop their understanding of topics covered in lectures in smaller group sessions. Outside of timetabled sessions, they'll need to dedicate time to self-study to prepare for coursework, presentations and exams. Learners can also join a range of student societies, including the Economics and Business Society, and Trading and Investment Society.

The MBA Finance graduates pursue exciting careers in a wide range of multinational companies, non-government and public sector organizations. Working in roles such as Financial Analyst, Financial Manager, Chief Financial Officer (CFO), Accounting Manager, Corporate Controller, Management Consultant among other career options.

courses.subject: Business Administration
courses.summaryHtml:
The Master of Business Administration with Extended Professional Practice is designed to provide students with a critical understanding of core business and management principles, including people management, marketing, and financial proficiency. The programme supports the development of strategic leadership capabilities and the ability to evaluate organisational positioning, making it suitable for individuals interested in leadership roles or entrepreneurial pathways, regardless of prior experience.

The course delivers a comprehensive and immersive learning experience, combining academic study with practical application. In addition to theoretical knowledge, students engage with real-world business contexts, supported by a 30-week postgraduate professional placement. Students who meet the academic requirements are responsible for securing their own placement, with structured guidance and support provided by the Future Success and Employability Team.

The two-year structure is divided into academic and practical components. The first year focuses on core academic modules, while the second year emphasises the application of knowledge through a professional placement, alongside the development of a reflective portfolio. The final semester also includes modules in Strategic Management Research and Financial Principles and Practice.

Students enrolled on the programme have access to a range of university resources, including the virtual learning environment, StudyNet, which offers access to course materials, peer collaboration, and an extensive collection of e-books and e-journals.

The programme also offers participation in the Young Enterprise Start-Up Programme, delivered in partnership with a leading UK enterprise education charity. Through this initiative, students collaborate in teams to establish and manage real businesses, taking on director-level responsibilities and participating in national and European competitions. This experience is designed to enhance practical skills in innovation, leadership, and entrepreneurship.

Teaching is delivered by research-active academic staff with extensive professional experience. Many are engaged in consultancy and advisory roles with major organisations, including FTSE-listed companies, global health institutions, and innovation-focused enterprises, ensuring that teaching is informed by current industry practice.

Studying an MBA can transform the way students think and the way they work, change the way others see them and open up new leadership and management opportunities. This full-time MBA enables students to develop the critical and reflective strategic leadership skills they need to succeed in an uncertain world, challenging their assumptions, cultivating flexible thinking, effective decision making and responsible management.

Hertfordshire MBA students will be supported by first-class facilities, including the virtual learning environment, StudyNet, which provides access to other students, lecture notes and over 100,000 e-books and e-journals. Students will also benefit from teaching and supervision by expert research-active staff, several of whom are world leaders in their field and act as consultants with leading organizations such as Roche, Camelot and BDO Hayward.

At every stage, students will have the opportunity to engage with business, learn through practical, work-based assignments and apply their knowledge in real-world settings in their role. Learners also have the opportunity to undertake a six-month applied business/enterprise experience, where they’ll set up and run their own business or social enterprise. While this supports their learning, they’ll be encouraged to develop and explore their business ideas and apply it directly to their career aspirations.

With an MBA, students can take a life-changing professional journey and expand their mind, skills, career potential and professional network. They can challenge their assumptions and gain a critical, reflexive approach to strategic leadership and management.

Program Description

The University of Liverpool Management School is one of an elite group of institutions worldwide to hold the gold standard 'triple-crown' accreditation from AACSB, AMBA and EQUIS. The MBA programme is ranked amongst the top 100 MBA programmes in the world featuring in The Economist 'Which MBA?' top 100 2019 global ranking, and achieved Tier 1 Status in CEO Magazine’s 2020 Global MBA Rankings. The Football Industries MBA is ranked at number 18 in the SportBusiness Postgraduate Course Rankings for 2020.

The MBA Football Industries (FIMBA) programme is the original, and still the only, Football industries MBA. As an MBA programme, it has the real business focus that management positions in modern sport demand. Focusing on the professionalism and business of the beautiful game, if students want to work in the global football industry— with clubs, governing bodies or related marketing, media and sponsorship companies— this is the MBA programme for them. The core elements of the programme—leadership, strategy, organizations, innovation, international business and the global environment, entrepreneurship and managing financial resources—are delivered in concentrated blocks to encourage a deeper understanding, with a strong emphasis on interactive teaching and learning. The specialist football modules apply business concepts to modern football. Students will gain a critical awareness of issues in football management, finance and law.

courses.summaryHtml:

The Roehampton MBA is designed with early career professionals in mind. It focuses on responsible leadership for sustaining competitive advantage and managing projects in a global context. It is designed to provide students with a comprehensive understanding of the main functional areas of business management such as strategy, marketing, finance and organisational change. The Roehampton MBA puts emphasis on the analysis of global organisations' best practices and strategies and it provides the opportunity to pursue a consultancy project with either a multinational corporation or a leading SME in London.

This programme has been designed with input from successful senior managers, and will equip students with an understanding of the needs of global business. This MBA will also prepare students for the challenges of senior management within an international business environment.

On successful completion of the MBA, students will have the knowledge, skills and confidence to lead and manage global business operations; to absorb complex information; to make difficult strategic decisions and communicate them effectively; and to lead and manage cross-cultural project teams.

The MBA with placement offers students the opportunity to complete a placement year (30 weeks) during Year 2. The aim of the placement experience is to provide a route for students to develop genuine and practical problem-solving skills in a professional context, to apply learned concepts into practice within their fields of specialism, and to enable students to gain a better understanding of their own abilities and employment potential.

This programme is dual accredited to a CMI qualification. Upon successful completion of the programme, the University of Roehampton on-campus students, will be eligible for a CMI L7 qualification in Strategic Management and Leadership (subject to passing the required mapped CMI modules and CMI moderation.

courses.summaryHtml:
The University of South Wales' Master of Business Administration (MBA) will develop the knowledge and skills to be a successful strategic business leader. It builds on a strong ethos of helping managers to solve real problems, and is designed for professionals who will make a strategic difference to the organizations in which they operate. Whether working in a public or private sector organization, professionals will learn how to integrate cutting-edge research and practice across all key business areas to achieve business transformation.

During the MBA, learners will develop key leadership skills such as creativity, innovation, collaboration and problem solving and be introduced to innovative business theory in a practical context.

The MBA will expose students to core areas of business with an emphasis on the strategic nature of decision-making through a diverse range of modules. Moreover, studies will be underpinned by the latest research undertaken by the South Wales Business School Research Group.

Taught sessions are delivered through self-guided study, lectures, seminars, group work, case studies and exercises. Students will have the opportunity to strategically analyze organizations, deliver presentations and prepare marketing and business plans. They'll also be part of a study visit to see first-hand how different companies operate. There are exciting guest lectures organized by the Business School, to broaden students' understanding of important subject areas.

The University is host to a vibrant, multicultural environment that provides an excellent opportunity for learners to gain an international perspective on business and different cultures and practices.

Employability is at the heart of this MBA, and USW aims to ensure that their students are innovative, creative and entrepreneurial, which helps make their graduates employable across the globe.

courses.summaryHtml:
The University of South Wales's MBA Global programme is a two-year MBA that offers students the opportunity to gain up to eight months work experience in the UK. The MBA Global programme builds on a strong ethos of helping managers and leaders solve complex business problems while developing professionals who will make a strategic difference within the context of their organizations.

It will develop leadership and strategic thinking skills required to build successful teams and navigate growth within an uncertain, resource-constrained and competitive business environment. Students will gain insights into how to prepare, plan and react efficiently to a rapidly changing business world.

Students will learn to evaluate the strategy and scope of a project while gaining an understanding of the project management process and the incumbent and emerging structural and leadership issues. Students will also be exposed to the process of identifying and selecting projects and managing projects using appropriate project management tools.

Depending on the length of the internship or work-placement, this block allows the student time and scope to develop a professional project report based on their work-placement or consultancy project internship to highlight and report their impact on the respective client organizations. Contact time and independent study hours will vary across blocks.

USW’s Global Choices programme of talks, workshops and masterclasses will expose students to guest lectures and seminars conducted by industry and academic leaders. The University is host to a vibrant, multicultural environment that provides excellent opportunities for students to gain global perspectives on business and management.

As a USW MBA Global graduate, students will become part of a global alumni network. In addition to an MBA Global qualification, graduates will also be eligible to apply for the Chartered Management Institute (CMI) Level 7 Diploma in Strategic Management and Leadership.
